ruleDefinitions.name: Use NTFS Short Name in Command Line
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect use of the Windows 8.3 short name. Which could be used as a method to avoid command-line detection

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\~1\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\~1\\\.bat.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\~1\\\.msi.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\~1\\\.vbe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\~1\\\.vbs.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\~1\\\.dll.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\~1\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\~1\\\.js.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\~1\\\.hta.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\~2\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\~2\\\.bat.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\~2\\\.msi.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\~2\\\.vbe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\~2\\\.vbs.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\~2\\\.dll.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\~2\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\~2\\\.js.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\~2\\\.hta.*")) AND  NOT (((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\WebEx\\\\WebexHost\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\thor\\\\thor64\\\.exe$")) OR process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\xampp\\\\vcredist\\\\VCREDI\\~1\\\.EXE.*")))
